    AI Overview
    Brian Gutiérrez (born June 17, 2003) is a
    Mexican-American professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Liga MX club Guadalajara (as of early 2026). A Chicago native, he developed as a standout Homegrown Player with Chicago Fire FC, recording over 100 appearances before his move, and represents the Mexico national team. 
    Key details regarding Brian Gutiérrez include: 
    • Background: Born in Berwyn, Illinois, he joined the Chicago Fire Academy before making his first-team debut.
    • Career Highlights: Known as a skilled playmaker, he was named to the MLS 22 Under 22 list in 2023 and 2024.
    • Playing Style: Primarily an attacking midfielder who can also play on the left, recognized for his technical ability and vision in the final third
      .
    • Transfer: Moved from Chicago Fire to Guadalajara (Chivas) in Liga MX, with his contract running through 2030. 
    Note: There is also a Brian C. Gutierrez, a personal injury attorney in Texas, who is not the athlete listed above https://gutierrez-law.com/about/brian-c-gutierrez/.

    Brian Gutiérrez is living the dream. His switch to Mexico from USMNT was approved in January and he made his debut on the same day. Last week, he scored his first goal for El Tri. He speaks about his childhood in Chicago, where he grew up in a Mexican household. “Since I was a child, when my parents were working after school, I would go with grandmother or my aunt and I would speak Spanish,” Gutiérrez said. “Throughout my childhood, I spoke Spanish at home with my family and relatives and friends.” “So that Mexican culture was always there.” “The truth is I’m living my dream right now and I want to continue like this and keep growing.” The 22-year-old recently joined Chivas from Chicago Fire and has made eight appearances so far. He’s aiming to make the World Cup squad with Mexico. If he does make it, it will be a proud moment for the Gutiérrez family. Let’s see if he makes it. [via TV Azteca Deportes]
